sourceRefs.locator: X.16, pp. 123–126: complaints, Leubovera’s answers, Didimia confirming her gift to the abbess and the judges’ reasons for retaining her.

X.16, from De palla quod repotarent to donatrix Didimia confirmavit: a silk wrap brought de parentibus (from her kin) was given to the abbess. The account distinguishes the original wrap, the altar covering and the trim.

summary.de: Didimia brachte den seidenen Überwurf von ihren Angehörigen mit und schenkte ihn der Äbtissin Leubovera. Laut deren Aussage entstand aus dem Stoff eine Altardecke, aus einem Rest ein Kleiderbesatz.
summary.en: Didimia brought the silk wrap from her relatives and gave it to Abbess Leubovera. According to the abbess the fabric furnished an altar cloth, and an offcut trimmed a dress.
